gate.why: These checks prevent noncanonical version labels, lost body or cab distinctions, and unsupported version assignments from generic specifications.
lines: Validate advertised trims and powertrain aliases against the Mexican-market make–model–year catalog before assigning its canonical version label.
Preserve body style, cab configuration, and conversion descriptors when extracting the complete version.
Require explicit version evidence or a verified catalog match rather than treating generic transmission metadata as a version.
